description: Randomization configuration for W11_Jun15 (auto-extracted from questionnaire.txt and manually corrected to capture all randomization types: (1) content_assignments — fill {{placeholder}} variables with pool draws, (2) option_order — shuffle answer-option codes within a question (supports fixed_last and retain_order_from), (3) item_order — shuffle sub-items within a single grid/matrix block, (4) question_order — shuffle a group of separate question blocks (used for grid-item groups like FAVORG_a-g and for KNOSCT13-20), (5) block_order — swap multi-question block groups (HL1 vs HL2), (6) form_randomization — reverse order of response options for a random half sample (KHJ2A/KHJ2B), (7) screen_order — multi-screen questions randomization (NEWS3).

content_assignments.description: Draw 2 of 4 science stories for HL1A, then the remaining 2 go to HL2A.
pool: Farmer Tries to Find Balance with Genetically Modified Crops

HL1C.description: RETAIN ORDER from HL1A, LAST OPTION (11) ALWAYS LAST
